items.title: Mean Green Hosting UAB in Home Finale
items.summary: DENTON – The UNT football team returns to action on Saturday, as the Mean Green will host UAB in their home finale at DATCU Stadium with kickoff set for 3 p.m. The game will be televised on ESPNU, with the radio broadcast set for 1190 AM/The Varsity Network.

items.title: North Texas Launches 2027 Football Season Ticket Renewal Campaign
items.summary: DENTON – UNT Athletics has officially launched its 2027 football season ticket renewal campaign, giving Mean Green fans the opportunity to secure their seats at DATCU Stadium for the second season under head coach Neal Brown.

items.title: Mean Green Drop Heartbreaker at Tulane
items.summary: NEW ORLEANS — The UNT football team's string of bad voodoo in New Orleans looked to be lifted early in Saturday's game at Tulane after the Mean Green jumped out to a quick 14-point lead near the end of the first quarter.

items.title: Mean Green Hit the Road to Face Tulane
items.summary: DENTON – The UNT football team returns to action on Saturday, as the Mean Green will travel to New Orleans to take on Tulane with kickoff set for 11 a.m. The game will be televised on ESPNU, with the radio broadcast set for 1190 AM/The Varsity Network.

items.title: White Named Doak Walker Award Semifinalist
items.summary: DALLAS — North Texas senior running back Jahiem White was named one of 10 semifinalists for the 2026 Doak Walker Award on Tuesday by the PwC SMU Athletic Forum Board of Directors.

items.title: UNT Drops First American Conference Game at UTSA
items.summary: SAN ANTONIO — UNT's perfect mark in American Conference play came to an end on Saturday night, as the Mean Green fell 35-16 to UTSA at the Alamodome, where UNT has won just one time in program history.

items.title: Mean Green Ready for Pivotal Road Game at UTSA
items.summary: DENTON – The UNT football team returns to action on Saturday night, as the Mean Green will travel to San Antonio to take on rival UTSA in the Alamodome with kickoff set for 8 p.m. The game will be televised on ESPNU, with the radio broadcast set for 1190 AM/The Varsity Network.

items.title: Dominant Second Half Leads North Texas to Homecoming Win Over Rice
items.summary: DENTON — Jahiem White rushed for 139 yards and three touchdowns, Tayven Jackson threw a touchdown pass and scored on a pair of runs, and North Texas beat Rice 52-23 on Saturday for the Mean Green's sixth consecutive win.

items.title: Mean Green Welcoming Rice for Homecoming Game
items.summary: DENTON – The UNT football team returns to action on Saturday, as the Mean Green host Rice for Homecoming with kickoff set for 3 p.m. The game will be televised on ESPNU, with the radio broadcast set for 1190 AM/The Varsity Network.

items.title: Jackson Named Earl Campbell Tyler Rose POTW
items.summary: TYLER, Texas – Fifth-year quarterback Tayven Jackson added to his growing list of accolades on Tuesday when he was named the Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Award Player of the Week after his standout performance in Thursday's 48-41 win over Florida Atlantic.
